reason: The repository purpose is to provide a web-facing dashboard for monitoring model quotas and spending, with a floating draggable card in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that pulls data from official APIs and a local session-log pricing engine, so it is primarily a visualization/usage-monitoring UI plugin with API integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 中提供一个可拖拽的额度与费用浮动面板，汇总展示 OpenRouter 与 DeepSeek 的余额、赠额和消费信息。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a draggable floating quota and cost panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, showing OpenRouter and DeepSeek balance and spending information from API and local usage calculation sources.

capabilities: Reads OpenRouter and DeepSeek quota/cost data from official APIs
Replays local session logs with pricing rules to compute chat, hourly, and daily spend
Displays usage/credit information in a draggable floating web GUI panel with persisted settings
